note: Defect register for the User Management plan. A defect appears in a session report when at least one of its test cases is Failed or Blocked in that run; 'design' defects (Figma file itself) are always listed. Add the ticket id in 'ticket' once filed. Baseline: runs of 13-14 Oct 2026 on testbox.

defects.title: "Filters" button opens nothing: no "Filter by" panel, so accounts cannot be filtered by country or registration date
Deactivated account has no "See details" on its banner (and no Activate action anywhere): the Activate flow cannot be reached, so a deactivated customer cannot be reactivated from the panel
Frozen and deleted accounts: no "See details" on the banner and no Unfreeze action, although the freeze warning tells agents to use "Unfreeze this account"
Deactivated, frozen and deleted accounts still show Edit details and the "..." menu (Deactivate / Freeze / Delete) — Figma hides all actions for non-Confirmed accounts
Back from Review details empties the reason typed on the Details step (Deactivate account, Freeze account, Deactivate payment method; Delete loses the chosen reason)
Delete flow: "Review details" is enabled with no reason selected, and "Send account snapshot to user's email" is off by default (Figma: on)
Result counter is wrong: "Showing -19 to 0 of 135 results" on page 1, "Showing 381 to 135 of 135" on page 2
Search does not find an account by full name (email and phone work)
Edit payment method opens with its own phone number flagged invalid ("Phone number must contain only digits" for +237…)
"Send code" is enabled for an invalid phone number ("12")
Wallet card "View details" opens /accounts/<id> instead of the Wallet account page; "Go to KYC page" stays on the profile
KYC alert cannot be dismissed (stays after clicking its X) and its body text is truncated / misspelled ("You ca reach to him")
Row checkboxes: ticking one row after Select all/clear selects every row; Payment methods table has no checkboxes (Figma has them)
No "Filters" button on Payment methods (Figma has one); status shown as lower-case "active"; empty state counter reads "Showing 1 to 0 of 0"
"Deactivate all" is enabled when no MFA method is active
No verified (green check) badge next to Email / Phone number for a confirmed account

Flow steps and labels differ from Figma: stepper "Reason for … — Review & verify" / "User information" instead of "Details — Review details" / "Contact Informations"; field "* Reason"; Freeze field label; deactivate button purple instead of red; "Delete account" menu item not red

Labels differ from Figma: tabs "Overview / Payment Methods", Title Case "Deactivate Account / Freeze Account / Delete Account / Deactivate Payment Method", "Authenticator App", "Saving Box", search placeholder "Search ...", browser title "Account overview", review date format 14/10/2026 vs "Oct 14, 2026"

Spelling and reused copy: "withdrawl", "This user haven't setup a savings goal", subtitle "Ensure the documents are clear and visible." on every flow, "Receive OTP by WhatsApp" instead of "Verify with WhatsApp", Add-method info box body missing
First list tab reads "Confirmed" (Figma "Active") while the badge reads "Confirmed" — design and product to pick one word
Every Review info box says "reset your TOTP setup" — wrong copy in Figma, copied by the app

Figma copy defects: "Reason for deactivation" on the Activate flow, account-deactivation warning on payment-method deactivation, "Add the agent username." under every Delete option, "froozen" / "Froozen", truncated KYC alert, "Update details" breadcrumb on Add payment method
Delete warning text differs from Figma (no mention of permanent erasure of history / backing up first)
